nodes.name: Your settings
nodes.notes:
owner_phone: your own number, with + and country code. Gets the alerts
business_name: how the assistant names your business
business_facts: what it may say: hours, address, payment, deadlines
tone: how it speaks
rules: what it must never do
ignore_phones: numbers it never answers, comma separated (family, suppliers)
handoff_words: a word or phrase that hands the chat to a person (phrases like "speak to a person" are safer than "person")
optout_words: a whole message that stops it for that customer
optin_words: a whole message that starts it again
confidence_threshold: below this a person answers (0 to 1)
human_hours: silence after a handover or after you write
hourly_cap: most automatic replies per customer per hour
audio_to_person: true hands voice notes to a person, false (default) answers them with nontext_reply
optout_reply: fixed text after STOP
optin_reply: fixed text after START
nontext_reply: fixed text for images, audio and the like
handoff_reply: fixed text when a person will answer

parameters.content:
### How it works
An AI agent answers WhatsApp support chats from your FAQ and hands the chat to a person when it should. A model can be wrong.

It answers EVERY private chat of EVERY number of the organization: use a dedicated organization, set Options > Number on the trigger, or list friends and suppliers in ignore_phones. STOP silences it for that customer until START.

When it hands over (the agent asks, a trigger phrase appears, too many replies) the customer gets a fixed text, the chat is held for human_hours and you get the reason, the last message and a contact card. When you type in a chat yourself, the assistant goes quiet for human_hours.

### Setup
1. Install @turbo-notify/n8n-nodes-turbo-notify (tested with 1.5.15).
2. Create a Turbo Notify API credential and a chat model credential, and select them on every Turbo Notify node and the model node.
3. Run the manual branch once: it creates the tables and four SAMPLE FAQ rows.
4. In Your settings replace owner_phone, business_name and business_facts, and write your own FAQ rows.
5. Test from another phone, then activate.

### Customization
Texts, limits and handoff words are in Your settings.

## Listen and check

Polls your number every minute and stops while the settings or the FAQ are still samples.

## Rules before the AI

STOP words, a person in the chat, non-text messages, handoff words and the hourly cap are decided in code, never by the model.

## Ask the AI

Answers only from the FAQ table and your facts. Anything unclear becomes a handoff.

## Reply

The contact state is saved first, then the answer goes out.

## Hand over to a person

Pauses the assistant in this chat, tells the customer, then sends you the reason and the contact card.

## Report what failed

Notes a reply or an alert that failed. When all events are done, the run fails with that list.

## Run once: tables and samples

Creates the faq and contacts_state tables, then adds four sample FAQ rows. Delete them before you activate.
**Replace these before you activate:** owner_phone, business_name, business_facts and the sample FAQ rows. Until then the workflow answers nobody.
